correctness.rationale: For every tree and marked set, each vertex path-pair trace is a complete multipartite marked-component partition. Distinct essential vertices and interior nonpendant compressed edges yield distinct partitions; external vertices give the single empty trace. Thus q=m+b+s+epsilon. With l marked leaves, degree sum gives b<=l-2 and at most m+b-1-l internal compressed edges, proving q<=3m-4, with equality conditions and explicit n-size witnesses. Maximal bipartite signatures are exactly compatible tree edge splits, yielding the binary-tree count. Extracted checker verifies 89,629 labelled-tree/mark-size instances and 1,3,15,105,945 extremal families for m=3..7. Finite checks are not used to prove the universal claim.

value.rationale: The exact sharp 2-parameter formula type growth, arbitrary marked-hull correction and simultaneous host-order frontier are natural quantitative invariants in finite model theory and tree path identification. At equality the complete signature family is a faithful representation of a labelled binary phylogeny, with exactly (2m-5)!! possible maximal families. This combines classification, sharp size and identification value rather than arbitrary finite data.
